scope: Source-asset content and role QC, not root acceptance, reproduction validation or complete visual inspection. No native rendering performed.
method: Viewed the named contact sheets and three detail views with view_image. Contact sheets fit source images to 200×170, event images to 240×175, palette composites to 300×230 and frieze details to240×240; standalone source-tile views are at up to600px. Source content was read from existing downloaded originals when present, otherwise exact public source URLs. GIFs were inspected at frame0 only.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Unprocessed reference portrait in Sighack Poisson tutorial was a source input, not generated output.
findings_and_repairs.action: Removed portrait6.jpg; retained generated Poisson drawings.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Source portrait l4.jpg in RGB averaging article was a source input.
findings_and_repairs.action: Removed source photo; kept final.gif computed circle reconstruction comparison.

findings_and_repairs.finding: All eight restored k-means palette figures pair a photograph with five computed palette swatches.
findings_and_repairs.action: Retained all eight with explicit input-plus-palette process roles. Visually verified all eight.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Fintech gala and Swiss Design Stories galleries mixed design outputs with distant/event photographs.
findings_and_repairs.action: Removed six Fintech event/signing views and five Swiss generic event views; retained design boards, packages and poster. Attribution names collaboration; no computational technique claimed.

findings_and_repairs.finding: McCabe friezes are 1024000×1024 panoramas; complete overview source tiles become1000×1.
findings_and_repairs.action: Replaced eight unusable strips with source-provided centre 1024×1024 detail tiles. Visually reviewed all eight and explicitly labelled partial-artwork detail scope.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Current McCabe Cellularity/Evotrees use256px Deep Zoom tiles. Level10 files are cropped tiles rather than larger whole-artwork previews.
findings_and_repairs.action: Retained level8 full overview tiles with resolution limitation, inspected one level10 crop of each but did not mislabel crops as whole artworks.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Sighack utility equation SVGs are not artwork. Hoff selected graph SVGs contain substantive generated graph illustrations.
findings_and_repairs.action: Removed equation/utility SVGs; retain six Hoff artwork/debug SVGs for collector SVG handling.

limits: Most selected images remain unviewed individually. Complete index adjudication is not complete visual acceptance.
Only still/frame0 images were inspected; optical/kinetic behavior and temporal variation remain unassessed.
Physical output, process/reference composites, gallery installations and generated digital images have different explicit roles.
Contemporaneous downloader receipts may be absent or failed during collection; final corpus receipts determine download success.
No undocumented algorithm is inferred solely from visual similarity.
